title: pratia brachyantha

The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Pratia brachyantha include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
